
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{--ground:#16261C;--deep:#1F3D28;--forest:#2B5336;--mid:#417C51;--sage:#50795F;--honey:#C08B41;--honeyl:#D6A868;--tint:#dbe7dd;--tint2:#eef4ef;--ink:#1F3D28;--grey:#5b6660}
@page{size:303mm 216mm;margin:0}
html,body{background:#fff;font-family:'Raleway',Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);font-weight:400;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}
body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8mm;padding:8mm 0}
@media print{body{display:block;padding:0;gap:0}}
.sheet{width:303mm;height:216mm;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 .3mm #ccc}
.sheet.outside{page-break-after:always;break-after:page}
@media print{.sheet{box-shadow:none;height:215.8mm}}
.panel{position:absolute;top:0;height:216mm;width:99mm;overflow:hidden}
.p0{left:3mm}.p1{left:102mm}.p2{left:201mm}
.p0.bleed{left:0;width:102mm}.p2.bleed{left:201mm;width:102mm}
.pad{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:3mm;height:210mm;padding:9mm 7mm 0}
.p0.bleed .pad{padding-left:10mm}.p2.bleed .pad{padding-right:10mm}
.dark{background:var(--deep);color:#fff}
.kicker{font-size:7pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--honey)}
h1{font-size:21pt;font-weight:800;line-height:1.08;margin:2mm 0 4mm;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.dark h1{color:#fff}
h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--honey)}
.dark h1 em{color:var(--honeyl)}
p{font-size:8.6pt;line-height:1.5;color:#3f4a44}
.dark p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88)}
.card{background:#fff;border:.25mm solid #e3e8e4;border-radius:3.5mm;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1mm 2mm rgba(22,38,28,.06)}
.cap{background:var(--deep);border-top:.8mm solid var(--honey);color:#fff;font-size:7.2pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2.3mm 3mm}
.card .note{padding:2.2mm 3mm 3mm;font-size:7.6pt;line-height:1.4;color:#4a554f}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3mm}
.grid img{width:100%;display:block}
/* crop marks */
.marks{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:5}
.marks i{position:absolute;background:#000;box-shadow:0 0 0 .18mm #fff}
.marks .h{height:.25mm;width:2.5mm}.marks .v{width:.25mm;height:2.5mm}
.marks .f{width:.25mm;height:2.6mm;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0 .5mm,transparent .5mm 1mm)}
.marks .f{background:#000}
.marks .lbl{position:absolute;font-size:5pt;color:#000;letter-spacing:.05em;background:#fff;padding:0 .4mm;line-height:1.1}
/* cover */
.cover{background:#000}
.cover .ph{position:absolute;inset:0;background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center top/cover no-repeat}
.cover .veil{position:absolute;inset:0;background:url(data:image/png;base64,) center/100% 100% no-repeat}
.cover .logo{position:absolute;left:38mm;top:103mm;width:47mm}
.cover .txt{position:absolute;left:10mm;right:8mm;top:150mm;color:#fff}
.cover .rule{width:10mm;height:1mm;background:var(--honeyl);margin-bottom:4mm}
.cover h1{font-size:26pt;margin:2mm 0 4mm}
.cover p{font-size:9pt;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.cover .url{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:12mm;text-align:center;font-size:7pt;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--honeyl);font-weight:700}
/* flap */
.flap .sub{font-size:6.6pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sage);margin:-1.5mm 0 4mm;line-height:1.6}
.flap .showroom{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:60mm;height:46mm;background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center/cover}
.flap .lifts{position:absolute;left:6mm;right:6mm;top:97mm}
.lift{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4mm;background:#fff;border:.25mm solid #e3e8e4;border-radius:3.5mm;padding:4mm 4.5mm;margin-bottom:4mm;box-shadow:0 1.2mm 3mm rgba(22,38,28,.08)}
.lift img{width:18mm;flex:none}
.lift b{display:block;font-size:8pt;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--deep);margin-bottom:1.2mm}
.lift span{font-size:7.8pt;line-height:1.4;color:#4a554f}
/* back */
.back .how{background:var(--forest);border-radius:5mm;padding:4mm 2mm 3.5mm;margin-bottom:4mm;text-align:center}
.back .how .k{font-size:6.8pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.28em;color:var(--honeyl);margin-bottom:4mm}
.steps{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.step{width:22.5mm;text-align:center}
.disc{width:12.5mm;height:12.5mm;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mid);margin:0 auto 2.5mm;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14pt;font-family:'Noto Color Emoji','Apple Color Emoji',sans-serif}
.step small{font-size:5.9pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--honeyl);text-transform:uppercase;display:block;line-height:1.25}
.qr{background:#fff;border-radius:3.5mm;border-top:1mm solid var(--honey);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4mm;padding:3.5mm;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:4mm}
.qr img{width:27mm;flex:none}
.qr b{font-size:10.5pt;font-weight:800;display:block;margin-bottom:1.5mm;color:var(--deep)}
.qr span{font-size:7.4pt;color:#4a554f;display:block;line-height:1.5}
.contacts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2.5mm 4mm;margin-bottom:4mm}
.contacts .k{font-size:6.6pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--sage);text-transform:uppercase}
.contacts .v{font-size:9pt;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-top:.8mm}
.dep{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:3mm;padding:3mm 4mm;margin-bottom:2.5mm}
.dep p{font-size:8pt}
.dep b{color:var(--honeyl);font-weight:700}
.green{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3mm;padding:.5mm 1mm 0;margin-bottom:4mm}
.green .leaf{width:9mm;height:9mm;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mid);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11pt;flex:none;font-family:'Noto Color Emoji',sans-serif}
.green p{font-size:7.8pt}
.team{text-align:center}
.team b{display:block;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:1.5mm}
.team .k{font-size:6.6pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.26em;color:var(--sage)}
.team img{width:72mm;display:block;margin:2mm auto 0}
.back .sig{position:absolute;left:7mm;right:7mm;bottom:5mm;border-radius:3.5mm;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.back .sig img{width:100%;display:block}
/* inside left: home / business */
.il .two{margin-top:1mm}
.il .card{margin-bottom:4mm}
.il .card img{width:100%;height:47mm;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.il .card .note{font-size:7.8pt;padding:2.4mm 3.5mm 3mm}
/* inside centre products */
.ic .grid{gap:2.8mm} .ic .card img{height:30mm;object-fit:cover} .ic .card .note{font-size:7.2pt;padding:1.9mm 2.8mm 2.6mm} .ic .cap{padding:1.9mm 2.8mm;font-size:6.8pt}
/* inside right spec */
.spec{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2.6mm;margin-bottom:4mm}
.spec div{background:#fff;border:.25mm solid #e3e8e4;border-radius:3mm;padding:2.4mm 3mm;box-shadow:0 1mm 2mm rgba(22,38,28,.06)}
.spec small{display:block;font-size:6.3pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sage);margin-bottom:1.2mm}
.spec b{font-size:8pt;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;display:block}
h2{font-size:10.5pt;font-weight:700;color:var(--deep);margin:0 0 2mm}
.row{display:flex;gap:3mm;align-items:flex-start;padding:1.8mm 0;border-bottom:.2mm solid #e8ece9}
.row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.row .d{width:7.5mm;height:7.5mm;border-radius:50%;background:var(--forest);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:9pt;flex:none;font-family:'Noto Color Emoji',sans-serif}
.row p{font-size:7.6pt;line-height:1.4}
.row b{color:var(--deep)}
.tip{background:var(--tint);border-left:1.2mm solid var(--deep);border-radius:0 3mm 3mm 0;padding:2.8mm 3.5mm;margin:3mm 0 4.5mm}
.tip p{font-size:7.6pt}
.tip b{color:var(--deep)}
.circles{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:3mm}
.circles img{width:24mm;height:24mm;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:.6mm solid var(--tint)}
/* inside band */
.band{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:303mm;height:36.6mm;background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center/cover}
